page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Page number top left, running head top centre. Catchword at the lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: zutum Theophylacti amicum, qui subdola familiaritate, sex dicitur Romanos pontifices, intra spatium tredecim annorum veneno suffocasse. Quo-rum hæc sunt nomina: Clemens secundus, Damasus secundus, Leo nonus, Victor secundus, Stephanus nonus, & Nicolaus secundus. Et ipsum postea Theophylactum, antiquum dominum suum ac magistrum, pœnitentiam magnam simulantem, idem Hildebrandus Leoni Papæ in dolo reconciliauit, ita ut eius etiam consilio in pluribus duceretur. Hæc ille. Henricus Imperator Beneuentum urbem Leoni dono dedit, & illi vicissim Bambergensis Ecclesiæ tributum remisit, palliumque Episcopo concessit. Vercellis concilium Leo coegit, Berengarij do-ctrinam[?] de sacramento damnans, quod nollet Eu-charisticum panem Dei loco adorari. Moguntiæ quoque synodum habuit: in qua pro sacrificulis ac monachis statuta quædam fecit, ne canes vel aves alerent, aut profana tractarent. Sacerdotum coniugium, sanctissimum Dei institutum, impulsore Hildebrando, in perpetuum hypocrita illic damnauit, & Ecclesiastica beneficia à laicis dari, profi-moniaca hæresi deinceps impostor decreuit. Cantus de sanctis aliquot, Sigeberto teste, composuit: & clericorum domos, ut casti fierent, prope templum extruendas esse statuit. Cum autem Norman
main_text.notes: Last line breaks off at the foot of the page; the catchword "ni po" sits at the lower right and is read as printed, with [?] because the letters are faint. "zutum" at the start is a fragment (the first letters are cut off by the scan edge). "profi-moniaca" is hard to read at the line end; the second half is probably "simoniaca", but it is copied as it appears. "do-ctrinam" is uncertain. The long s appears as f in "fex" and "fuffocaffe", read here as sex and suffocasse. Printed "compofuit" is read as composuit. Printing errors (such as "Cantus" for the sense "canon") are left as printed where clear.
